deprecation_note: gemini-2.0-flash and gemini-2.5-flash are no longer available to new users. The API recommends gemini-3.8-flash as the successor. Updated 2026-10-14.
api_key_source: Environment variable GEMINI_API_KEY loaded via python-dotenv
retrieval_method: TF-IDF cosine similarity over a local JSON guideline knowledge base
known_limitations: Requires a valid GEMINI_API_KEY with quota.
gemini-3.8-flash may return HTTP 503 (temporarily unavailable) during high-demand periods; this is transient — retry after 30 seconds.
Gemini-generated line numbers are heuristic and not guaranteed to match submitted code.
LLM findings are advisory only; not confirmed vulnerabilities.
Static analysis covers a limited rule set; not a replacement for a certified SAST tool.
Model availability subject to Google API changes; update model_name here if a 404 NOT_FOUND error is received.
notes: Model name is configurable in this file and read at runtime by gemini_integration.py.
